authority_basis.summary: Derive canonical Frobenius candidates on the intrinsic-prime object and test their composition and typing.

operations.title: Initiality forces Frobenius rigidity on conditional pi_0
operations.statement: The conditional pointed pi_0 is the initial commutative semiring, so its only unital semiring endomorphism is identity. The additive classifiers f_n compose as f_m f_n=f_mn but are unital only at n=1. Identity satisfies Frobenius congruences for every intrinsic prime but is prime-independent; any nontrivial Frobenius spectrum requires a larger source-derived object.
operations.scope: Conditional pi_0 categorical rigidity; no full-Carrier lift, Witt object, Euler factor, or physical operation.

operations.title: Unitality hostile test for additive power classifiers
operations.procedure: Evaluate every additive classifier f_n at the distinguished multiplicative unit U. Since f_n(U)=nU, enforce unitality f_n(U)=U.
operations.expected_result: Only n=1 survives. Any nonidentity unital semiring endomorphism of the initial object falsifies the rigidity theorem.
